card.name: Large counts after "more than"
card.fires_on: Numbers and the category noun right after "more than" or "over" in a big count, such as digits in a long number or "types of" and "species of". It marks the spot where a total of kinds or items is being stated.

modes.label: Digits in big numbers
modes.description: Digits or spaces inside a large figure that follows "more than".
modes.example: the more than13<<6>>,000 speakers of Mā

modes.label: Kind nouns after the count
modes.description: Words like types, species or languages right after a stated number.
modes.example: have labeled more than 3500<< types>> of anurans

card.writes: It seems to push toward words for categories or counts and away from words like fresh or raw.
card.plain: It lights up when a text says there are more than some large number of kinds or items.
